description: List contacts (people) in Close. Returns a `data` array of contacts with id, lead_id, name, title, emails, and phones, plus `has_more` / `total_results`. Optionally filter to one lead with `lead_id`. Page with `_limit` / `_skip`.

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

lead_id.description: Optional lead ID to filter contacts to a single lead

name: close_list_contacts
